description: Hosted deployments (the claude.ai connector): get signed upload URLs so skylight_upload_photo / skylight_import_events_from_photo can take a photo or video the server cannot read from your disk. For each file returns {blobKey, uploadUrl, curl, expiresAt}: PUT the file to uploadUrl with exactly the Content-Type shown (the curl does it), then call the photo tool with image_blob_key set to blobKey. Types: jpg, jpeg, png, heic, gif, webp, mp4, mov (max 200 MiB). Writes nothing to Skylight; each URL is a credential to write that one upload and expires in 30 minutes. Refused when this server has no blob store (a local install: pass image_path instead). Up to 10 files per call.

files.description: One entry per file to upload: {filename, mimeType?}. The filename (a bare name, no path) is what Skylight will see; its extension sets the type when mimeType is omitted.

filename.description: Filename the upstream will show — a bare name, no path, not starting with a dot.

mimeType.description: MIME type. Default: inferred from the filename extension. The PUT must send exactly this Content-Type.

name: skylight_upload_slots
